evidence: Implements BIP 54 consensus validation rules in src/consensus/ and src/validation.cpp, governing transaction sigops, 64-byte transaction invalidation, coinbase timelocks, and block timestamp constraints.
rationale: BIP 54 resolves long-standing consensus-level vulnerabilities including quadratic legacy sigops CPU exhaustion, Merkle tree leaf collisions (CVE-2017-12842), and timewarp difficulty manipulation. While critical to consensus health if deployed, the rules are configured without mainnet activation (always active only on regtest), making this a strategically important milestone for upstream evaluation and testing rather than an urgent release-critical emergency.
